--- name: meridian-glass description: Meridian Glass design system rules for this project's UI. Use when building or changing any screen, component, form or style, when porting an existing screen onto Meridian Glass, or when checking UI against Meridian Glass. --- # Meridian Glass MeridianGlass is compact black and white for AI products: ink and paper, greys as ink at alphas, colour only for status, and glass only on the one action a group leads with; its secondaries stay flat. Build with these components before writing markup. ## Setup Once, in the root layout: put the "meridian-glass" class on `` or the root element of the UI, with `MeridianGlassPortalProvider` inside it. Meridian Glass's styles and tokens apply only inside that class. Menus, dialogs, popovers and toasts render at the end of the body; MeridianGlassPortalProvider keeps them inside the scope, and without it they lose every token. `import {MeridianGlassPortalProvider} from '@/lib/meridian-glass/portal'` `{children}` ## Steps 1. For a whole screen, start from a block under Blocks when one fits: install it, then swap its sample data and copy for the real ones. 2. Pick the components the screen needs from the index below. Fetch each one's page before using it: it has the props, variants and that component's rules. 3. Build only from those components and the tokens under Tokens, inside an element with the "meridian-glass" class. Import each from the path in the index; support pieces are under Imports. Dark mode: put data-theme="dark" on the meridian-glass element or any ancestor, such as . The theme does not follow the system setting (prefers-color-scheme) on its own. 4. Frame the screen with the Page shell. If a token or component is missing, stop and say so. Do not invent one. 5. Ask the person only when the screen needs a fact you were not given, such as a model name or a limit; decide everything else from these rules and say what you chose. 6. Porting an existing screen: swap one piece at a time for its component, keep the behavior and copy, and delete the old styles once nothing uses them. For a whole app, run migrate-design-system when it is installed. 7. Lint: install it once with `npx shadcn@latest add https://happyhands.cc/r/meridian-glass/lint.json`, then run `npx eslint -c meridian-glass.eslint.config.mjs .`. Each message names the fix. 8. Review before you finish: run the lint and fix every error, then render the screen at 390 and 1280 wide, check it against the global rules and the anti-slop list, fix the worst defect, and check again. Done when no MUST or NEVER is broken and no raw color, size or font is left. Run ui-review when it is installed. ## Priority order When rules conflict, the earlier item wins. 1. Accessibility and keyboard behaviour 2. Tokens by role, never raw values 3. Existing components and recipes, never rebuilt 4. The three signatures: glass on pressables, the shell card, pills for one-line controls 5. Compact spacing and type ## Global rules 1. glaze-components-first MUST Use a Meridian Glass component or recipe before writing markup; fetch its page before you build. Because each one already carries the focus ring, the states and the glass a hand-built copy forgets. - Correct: `import {Button} from '@/components/meridian-glass/ui/button'` 2. glaze-scope MUST Wrap Meridian Glass UI in className="meridian-glass" with MeridianGlassPortalProvider inside it, so overlays keep the tokens. Because a menu or dialog renders at the end of the body, outside the scope, and would lose every colour. - Correct: `

Because two glass pills side by side split the eye and neither reads as the next step. - Correct: `` - Wrong: `` 5. glaze-glass-on-pressables NEVER Put glass on anything a person does not press: cards, headers, badges, fields, menus. Because glass is the one sign that a thing can be pressed, and glass everywhere turns it into a theme. - Correct: `

Because Meridian Glass Mono's letters are 26% wider than Meridian Glass Sans's, so at one size mono reads a size bigger. - Correct: `run_8f2a91` - Wrong: `run_8f2a91` 9. glaze-focus-ink MUST Keep the 2px ink :focus-visible ring on every control and never outline: none; a field shows focus by darkening its line. Because keyboard users lose their place without it, and a coral ring would read as an error. 10. glaze-sentence-case MUST Write sentence case and a verb with its object on actions; no emoji, no em dash. Because every screen then sounds like one person talking. - Correct: `` - Wrong: `` ## Page shell Every screen sits in this frame. - Root: `

`, one per page - A phone moment: a component at `w-full max-w-sm`, sized to its content, with its one action inline (a Card footer or a row of Buttons); the screen around it supplies the header and the page colour ## Anti-slop The habits of generated UI that Meridian Glass bans. Details: https://happyhands.cc/systems/meridian-glass/foundations/anti-slop.md - anti-slop-no-glass-sprawl NEVER Spread the glass past what is pressed: no glass cards, headers, badges or inputs. Because glass on everything turns the signature into a theme, and nothing reads as the thing to press. - Wrong: `
` - anti-slop-no-decoration NEVER Add a gradient, a blob, a texture, a grid or dot background, a glow or a backdrop blur. Because Meridian Glass is black and white, and decoration competes with the one ink action. - Wrong: `
` - anti-slop-no-shadow-reflex NEVER Reach for a shadow to make a card or a menu stand out. Because Meridian Glass draws none; a card is a shell, an overlay is paper with a ring. - Wrong: `
` - anti-slop-no-stat-cards NEVER Lay out a row of equal cards each holding one number. Because equal boxes make every number equally loud, so the one that matters is lost. - Wrong: `RunsEvalsCost` - anti-slop-no-icon-tiles NEVER Put an icon in a tinted tile or circle beside a heading. Because the tile says nothing the heading does not and reads as a button. - Wrong: `

Agents

` - anti-slop-no-side-rail NEVER Mark a card, row or message with a coloured bar on one edge. Because the bar reads as a status nobody defined. - Wrong: `
` - anti-slop-no-status-dots NEVER Mark a status, an unread count, today or a series with a small round dot; a status is a glyph and a word. Because a dot says only that something is there, so its meaning rides on hue alone and every dot on the page reads the same. - Wrong: ` Passed` - anti-slop-earn-the-card MUST Group with space first; use a card around one thing a person acts on, and never a card in a card. Because a card around everything flattens the page into equal tiles. - anti-slop-no-eyebrow NEVER Put a small label, a category or a number above a title. Because the heading already names the section, and the label is a second voice saying less. - Wrong: `

Because capitals are slower to read and shout. - Wrong: `Queued` - anti-slop-no-emoji NEVER Use emoji in copy, titles or buttons, or as icons. Because emoji render differently on every device and turn a tool into a chat thread. - Wrong: `` - anti-slop-no-hype NEVER Write seamless, effortless, supercharge, unleash or blazing; say what happens. Because people trust a product that states the fact. - Wrong: `Supercharge your agents.` - anti-slop-no-mono-cosplay NEVER Set labels, headings or numbers in mono to look technical; mono is for what a person copies. Because mono everywhere reads as a terminal costume and hides which value is the ID. - Wrong: `

` - anti-slop-no-fake-data SHOULD Fill examples with believable data; never Lorem ipsum, John Doe or 1,234. Because placeholder data hides the truncation and alignment problems real data shows. - anti-slop-no-stream-effects NEVER Blink a cursor, sweep a shimmer or fade in each word of a streamed answer. Because the effect slows reading and makes the layout jitter. - Wrong: `▍` - anti-slop-no-scroll-reveal NEVER Fade or slide content in as it scrolls into view. Because content that hides until scrolled is missed. - Wrong: `` - anti-slop-dialog-controlled MUST Open a Dialog with open and onOpenChange; never mount it only while open. Because a dialog that unmounts skips its exit and loses the trigger it returns focus to. ## Reject list - No brand accent, no gradient, no shadow, no blur. - No glass off pressables, no square one-line controls. - No mono at the sans size, no weight 700, no capitals. ## Imports - `import {useOverlayOpen, overlayModel, overlayOpenChanged, overlayMayClose, overlayRunStarted, overlayRunSettled, isThenable, closesAfter, useDefaultAction, useScrollBody, overlaySurface, overlayShell, overlayPanel, overlayMotion, scrimClass, menuPopupClass, menuItemClass, menuCheckItemClass, menuLabelClass, menuSeparatorClass} from '@/lib/meridian-glass/overlay'`: What every overlay shares: the ringed paper surface and the card-shaped modal, the way they appear, the list rows, and for Dialog and Sheet the open state that waits for a running action and Enter on the footer's default action. - `import {isPart} from '@/lib/meridian-glass/children'`: isPart, which tells which part a child element is even when a server component composed it, for the compound components that read their children. - `import {EMPTY_VALUE, CHART_EMPTY, fixed, durationUnitFor, formatDurations, countUnitFor, formatCounts, cssNumber, useScrollTabStop, useLoadingPhase} from '@/lib/meridian-glass/data'`: Support file: one unit per column of numbers, a token read at runtime, the scroll box tab stop and the placeholder timing the data components share. - `import {controlHeight, cn, mergeClass, mergeRefs} from '@/lib/meridian-glass/utils'`: cn, which merges class names and resolves conflicts between Meridian Glass's type roles and glass keys; mergeClass, which keeps Meridian Glass's classes when a caller passes a className function; mergeRefs; and controlHeight, the one height formula for one-line controls. - `import {Icon} from '@/components/meridian-glass/icon'`: The one import point for icons: Phosphor at regular weight, 14px in controls. - `import {MeridianGlassPortalProvider, useMeridianGlassPortal, useMeridianGlassModal, cycleTab, coarsePointer} from '@/lib/meridian-glass/portal'`: Puts overlays inside the .meridian-glass scope so they keep its tokens, and makes the page inert behind a modal. - `import {MeridianGlassDirection, useDomDirection} from '@/lib/meridian-glass/direction'`: Hands the reading direction to Base UI and to popups opened from a right-to-left subtree. ## Icons Import a glyph beside Icon from the path under Imports and pass it in: ``.
